preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of transformations k is between 0 and 2n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= y_prime <= n for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation involves vertices within the range 1 to n.
The number of transformations listed matches k.

postconditions.expression: all((x, y) in edges or (y, x) in edges for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation deletes an existing edge (x, y) or (y, x).

postconditions.expression: all((x, y_prime) not in edges and (y_prime, x) not in edges for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation adds a new edge (x, y') or (y', x) that does not already exist.

postconditions.expression: all(len(Vx) > len(Vy) for x, y, y_prime in transformations for Vx, Vy in [split_tree(edges, x, y)])
postconditions.description: After deleting edge (x, y), the component containing x has more vertices than the component containing y.
